name: pageLoading alone
code: import { effect } from '@reely/signals'; import { pageLoading } from '@reely/router'; effect(() => console.log(pageLoading()));

name: a router with an effect
code: import { effect } from '@reely/signals'; import { defineRoutes, startRouter } from '@reely/router'; const main = document.body; const router = startRouter(defineRoutes({ '/': () => 'inbox' }), { show: (page) => { main.textContent = page; return main; }, fail: (error) => error.message }); effect(() => console.log(router.path()));
